column3: soorat 1.2.0 has no public skinned pipeline: no type builds pbr_skinned.wgsl (only gpu_smoke compiles it) or binds JointUniforms; SkinnedVertex3D, Skeleton and AnimationClip are CPU-only

column6: 6x6 tinted translucent sprites with atlas UVs, three z-sorted overlays (one rotated), 4x4 sRGB atlas, nearest sampling
grid, circle, box, sphere and axes through LinePipeline over a depth-cleared target
checker-textured ellipsoid (rotated, non-uniform scale) under directional + point + spot lights, dim IBL
plane, cube and sphere with a 512 directional shadow map (PCF 3x3)
metallic sphere lit only by IBL: 4x4 flat irradiance, 16x16 gradient prefiltered cube (5 mips), prakash 32x32 BRDF LUT
glossy HDR sphere (Rgba16Float) -> bloom threshold/blur -> ACES tone map with bloom composite 1.0
SSAO (16 samples) from the depth of the plane/cube/sphere scene, constant +Z normal
64 particles (xorshift32 seed) after 32 compute steps of 1/64 s, drawn as sprites
goonj room-mode pattern 9x9 as a heat-mapped height field (mode_pattern_to_mesh)
pravash 9x9 shallow-water surface with a bump and a dip (shallow_water_to_mesh)
bijli 8x8 Ez field slice, signed map (field_slice_2d_to_mesh)
